title: Reported Speech: Pronoun Practice — Quiz 125
content:
## Reported Speech: Pronoun Practice

Choose pronouns that reflect who spoke and who is being reported.

### Lesson focus

1. Gopal said, “I'm fine.”
2. Sohni said, “I'm fine.”
3. I said, “I'm fine.”
4. Father and his friends said, “We are fine.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
